It can be seen that the accumulated snow on several soil mounds is mainly preserved on the slopes on the right side of the image, while the slopes on the left side have relatively less accumulated snow and more melting. Reasoning: The prompt states that it snowed on the fifth day of the first lunar month, the photo was taken on the twelfth day of the first lunar month, and the accumulated snow was not affected by human activities, so the differences in the distribution of residual snow are mainly caused by natural snowmelt. Handan is located in the Northern Hemisphere; in winter, the solar altitude is relatively low, the south-facing slope is the sunny slope, receives more sunlight, and accumulated snow melts quickly; the north-facing slope is the shady slope, receives less sunlight, and accumulated snow is preserved for a longer time. Since more accumulated snow is preserved on the slope on the right side of the image, it can be judged that the right side of the image is the north-facing slope. When facing a certain direction, if the right side is north, then the photographer is facing west. Therefore the camera was mainly shooting toward the west, that is, the shooting direction was from east to west.
